title: The Gate's Reflection
text: At the very source of the rift the Gate is a mirror, and in it each of you sees your House as it will be when this is over. The throne is behind you, empty, waiting. Something in the glass is waiting too, very still, to see what you will do.

options.label: Look into the Gate, and face whatever your House is to become.

outcomes.text: Your House stands in the glass, and stands well. Whatever comes next, you have seen it through already.
The glass shows your House, and then it shows what the throne will cost. You do not look away fast enough.

options.label: Look away. The future can wait until the fighting is done.

outcomes.text: Whatever was in the glass, it was not for now. Your mind is clear for the fight ahead.
